svg.text: Phase 3 — the detector, module by module
Task groups 3.1 and 3.2, inside ADA_ECU/detector/. The unproven dependency is taken first, before any code exists.
The library-availability lane runs before any detector file is written, because the whole
phase rests on three libraries having a ready-made build for the node's processor. Had it
failed, the answer was an older version, a different base image, or a long compile — a
design decision, not something an implementing agent may pick on the spot.
closed; verified by the detector test lane
